description: This file defines the SoftKeyboard class, which extends PublicNotices and manages keyboard behavior, including handling selection updates and generating a settings input method ID.

classes.name: SoftKeyboard
classes.description: Main class for the soft keyboard, extending PublicNotices, handling selection updates, and providing input method ID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the keyboard, setting up a Handler if delayed selection updates are enabled.

methods.name: onUpdateSelection
methods.description: Handles updates to the selection, optionally delaying the update to simulate slow input connection updates.

methods.name: getSettingsInputMethodId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this input method, based on the component name.
